records.cueHe: אמר ליה רבה בר רב חנן לרבא: למה לי הכשר
records.about: why the flesh should need to be rendered susceptible at all, given that while attached it imparted severe impurity by virtue of its parent limb
while attached the flesh served the limb only to constitute it a limb, performing the role of wood rather than of food, so it still needs to be rendered susceptible
